mobile.accountPageIntro: Offline accounts are supported on mobile: pick a player name and you can play single-player or on offline servers. Microsoft accounts need a browser sign-in and are not wired up here yet.
mobile.accountOfflineHint: Offline accounts need no password — the player name is the name you appear as in game.
mobile.accountConfirmDelete: Delete account “{0}”? This cannot be undone.
mobile.accountEmptyHint: Add an offline player name on the right to start playing.
mobile.accountMicrosoftHint: Requires a browser sign-in with Microsoft and is not available on mobile yet; add it on the desktop app instead.
mobile.accountOfflineNameInvalid: Only letters, digits and underscore are allowed (1–16)
mobile.accountOfflineExists: That player already exists — switched to it
mobile.launcherNoInstance: No instances yet — tap “New instance” at the top to install one right on this device
mobile.instancesLaunchPending: Launching is not wired up on mobile yet
mobile.instancesRuntimeMissing: No mobile Java runtime installed (requires an Amethyst (AngelAuraMC) OpenJDK port)
mobile.settingsRuntimePlanned: The Java runtime and graphics translation layer arrive in a later build
mobile.settingsRuntimeNativeMissing: The native launch layer is missing from this build (libmchubjvm.so)
mobile.newIntro: Versions and files are downloaded and installed on this device straight from the official sources — no PC needed.
mobile.newLoaderUnsupported: This build has no bundled java command, so this loader cannot be installed on-device; use Vanilla or Fabric instead.
mobile.newInstanceNameInvalid: The instance name cannot contain \ / : * ? " < > | or similar characters
mobile.newInstalling: Installing — keep the app in the foreground…
